---
title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: Gabriella Buccellato
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

```


```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(
    day_of_week = factor(
      day_of_week,
      levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false

average_births <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(
    average_births = mean(births, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false

ggplot(average_births, aes(
  x = date_of_month,
  y = factor(month, levels = 12:1),
  fill = average_births
)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_y_discrete(
    breaks = as.character(12:1),
    labels = month.name[12:1],
    name = "Month"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:31,
    name = "Day of Month"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Mean Births") +
  labs(title = "Average Daily Births (1994–2014)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false

christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    christmas_births = sum(
      births[month == 12 & date_of_month == 25],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    baseline_births = mean(
      births[
        month == 12 &
        date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    christmas_pct_of_baseline =
      100 * christmas_births / baseline_births,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

christmas_births
```

```{r}
#| message: false

christmas_births <- christmas_births |>
  mutate(
    weekday = wday(
      make_date(year, 12, 25),
      label = TRUE,
      abbr = FALSE
    )
  )

ggplot(
  christmas_births,
  aes(x = year, y = christmas_pct_of_baseline)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = weekday), size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Christmas Births Compared with Surrounding Days",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Christmas Births (% of Baseline)",
    color = "Weekday on Christmas"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| message: false

births_model <- lm(
  births ~ year + month + day_of_week,
  data = births_tibble
)

summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
#| message: false

births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(
    pct_resid = 100 * resid(births_model) / mean(births)
  )

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(
    pct_resid = mean(pct_resid, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = make_date(2001, month, date_of_month)
  ) |>
  arrange(date)

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
#| message: false

calendar_resid_plot <- calendar_resid |>
  rename(
    calendar_date = date,
    mean_pct_resid = pct_resid
  )

holiday_labels <- tibble(
  calendar_date = make_date(2001, c(1, 11, 12), c(1, 22, 25)),
  holiday = c("New Year's Day", "Thanksgiving", "Christmas")
) |>
  left_join(
    calendar_resid_plot,
    by = "calendar_date"
  )

ggplot(calendar_resid_plot,
       aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = holiday_labels,
             aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid),
             color = "firebrick", size = 2,
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = holiday_labels,
            aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid, label = holiday),
            color = "firebrick", angle = 45, hjust = 0,
            vjust = 1, size = 3,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Birth Residuals Across the Calendar",
    x = "Calendar date",
    y = "Mean residual (% of average daily births)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
